invariants.rationale: The method always returns a non-null List due to Collectors.toList().
Every fileId in the result list must be non-null as per fg.getFileId().
The use of the distinct() operation guarantees all elements are unique.
If the result is empty, getLatestFileSlices yielded no slices for this partition.
partitionPath is passed to the method and required by getLatestFileSlices; null may not be allowed.
